title: PAPERBENCHX: Can AI Reproduce Science Across Disciplines?
abstract: arXiv:2610.39744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before AI can be trusted to discover new science, it should be able to reproduce what science already knows. Reproduction provides a rigorous checkpoint for an AI scientist: the target claim is known, yet recovering it still requires translating an incomplete scientific description into an executable experiment and producing evidence that can be independently verified. Existing research-reproduction benchmarks largely focus on AI and machine learning, where experiments share relatively homogeneous software stacks. Extending this capability across scientific disciplines introduces a different challenge: agents must operate domain-specific scientific software, make physical and numerical choices, diagnose long-running computations, and distinguish valid evidence from merely plausible outputs. We introduce PAPERBENCHX, a benchmark of 93 expert-constructed paper-reproduction tasks spanning 12 research areas across electromagnetics, photonics

translated_title: PAPERBENCHX：AI能够跨学科复现科学吗？
translated_abstract: 在信任AI去发现新科学之前，它首先应当能够复现科学界已经知晓的成果。复现为AI科学家提供了一个严格的检验点：目标结论是已知的，但要重新获得它，仍需要将不完整的科学描述转化为可执行的实验，并产出能够被独立验证的证据。现有的研究复现基准主要聚焦于人工智能和机器学习领域，这些领域的实验共享相对同质的软件栈。而将这一能力扩展到其他科学学科则带来了截然不同的挑战：智能体必须操作特定领域的科学软件，做出物理和数值上的选择，诊断长时间运行的计算，并区分有效证据与仅仅看似合理的输出。我们提出了PAPERBENCHX，这是一个由93个专家构建的论文复现任务组成的基准，涵盖电磁学、光子学等12个研究领域。
tldr: PAPERBENCHX是一个包含93个专家构建任务、覆盖电磁学和光子学等12个研究领域的跨学科基准，旨在检验AI能否将不完整的科学描述转化为可执行实验并产出可独立验证的证据，弥补了现有基准仅局限于AI和机器学习领域的不足。
en_tdlr: PAPERBENCHX is a benchmark of 93 expert-constructed paper-reproduction tasks spanning 12 research areas including electromagnetics and photonics, designed to test whether AI can translate incomplete scientific descriptions into executable experiments and produce independently verifiable evidence, addressing the limitation of existing benchmarks that focus only on AI and machine learning.
